name: Voltage-gated calcium channel survey
description: The Cav alpha1 genes across the tree-of-life panel - the baseline search: what the databases already know, before any census work. CACNA1C and CACNA1S are among the best-annotated channels in any vertebrate genome, so this is also the sanity check that a search returning few hits is a real absence rather than a broken client. The sister panel (from the hazard registry) puts SCN5A and NALCN in front of the discovery scorer, which is the point: the nearest neighbour of a calcium channel is very often a sodium channel.
